source: Gallup, "Acceptance of Gambling Reaches New Heights" (2018): https://news.gallup.com/poll/235379/acceptance-gambling-reaches-new-heights.aspx
method: Transcribed from Gallup's published article (table 'Views on Gambling Differ Significantly Within Subgroups'), not computed from microdata. Shares of U.S. adults saying gambling is morally acceptable / morally wrong, by religious service attendance (Values and Beliefs poll, May 2018). The two do not sum to 100% because other responses are not reported. Latter-day Saints are not broken out.
